browser_caption_surface_label: Example browser-generated live-captions posture for official voter-information media routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official recordings, embeds, and clips so browser- or platform-generated captions and translated subtitles remain subordinate to the official recording, any reviewed official transcript/caption, and the named help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow transcript or translated publication.

reviewed_media_caption_contexts.context_note: Reviewed browser- or platform-generated same-language captions over already-open official media playback.
Reviewed translated subtitle overlays produced by browser or platform settings rather than by an office-published subtitle file.
Reviewed whether copied caption text could be mistaken for an office-issued transcript edition.
Reviewed whether the route still tells the truth when generated caption support is unavailable, blocked, or disabled.

official_caption_or_transcript_note: Where the office publishes reviewed captions, subtitles, or a transcript, that published text remains the authoritative text support; generated captions remain convenience support only.
subtitle_translation_boundary_note: Translated generated subtitles are treated as optional convenience output and not as a reviewed official multilingual publication unless the office separately publishes and stands behind that translated text.
generated_caption_variance_note: Availability, language coverage, privacy posture, and retention differ across browsers, operating systems, devices, and user settings.
privacy_and_retention_note: The service preserves route IDs, reviewed caption contexts, policy notes, and timestamps rather than individualized generated caption logs, microphone captures, or device-specific accessibility fingerprints.
portable_record_boundary_note: Copied or exported generated caption text is not automatically treated as a current official transcript edition or portable record.
current_help_recovery_note: When generated captions are absent, mistranslated, delayed, or ambiguous, the route points back to the current official page, transcript/help lane, or named office contact instead of pretending the generated text is sufficient.
